repairs.rationale: Same failure as dd-06-q3 and the same resolution. The first repair took 'slow, squishy, inconsistent' out of every accept string but left 'squishy' in the dd-08 brief prompt, and it is verified present in dd-08's human span (brooker-whats-easy-whats-hard.txt:45). The brief-echoing reply - the rendering every condition produces, because the brief hands the phrasing over - scored 12/15 = 0.8 CORRECT under the old key and 8/14 under the new one, so the repair converted a mild H advantage into an item all five conditions fail. Since the phrase is in H's span, H produces it whatever the brief says, so the key has to accept it; and since an accept list is a disjunction, accepting the idiomatic rendering does not require it. The original defect was that every string demanded the author's three adjectives, which made voice-copying the only route to a point; that is closed by the neutral strings, which now pass on their own. Six strings, each tested individually rather than assumed: the neutral 'needs human feedback / has a specification' short form, the idiomatic squishy form, the machine-checkable form, the 'iterates without a human' form, the elliptical 'one needs a person in the loop, the other has a spec' form (which names neither artefact and would otherwise fail every draft I tried), and a 'judged without a human / judged against its specification' form, which shares only four content words with the neutral rendering and therefore needed its own string rather than a loosened shared one. Verified against a replica of tools/comprehension.py: six correct renderings pass; nine lazy or wrong replies fail, including both half answers ('The website needs a human.', 'The engine has a specification.'), 'One needs a person in the loop.', 'Feedback loops matter.', 'The website is harder in the long run.', 'A website and an engine are compared.' and 'NOT STATED'. I deliberately did not loosen the short string to the four bare nouns (website, human, engine, specification), which would have caught every rendering in one string but also passed a reply that merely names the four things without asserting the asymmetry.
